_about: T6.1: the full UAR extract (216 accounts) of the sample mentee, written where the pack ships only its first 60 rows.
plan: The account has an approval ticket.
The account belongs to a named person the HR roster knows, and is still in use: a login in the 90 days before the review date, unless the reviewer decided Revoke.
Name; HR status; Last login; Review decision
The account does not hold both roles of a toxic combination in the SoD matrix.
The reviewer is not the account holder.
The review decision is made (Keep or Revoke), and a Revoke was executed within 5 working days of the review date.

The HR roster shows neither a termination date nor a role change date. A leaver's account must be disabled, and a mover's access re-validated within 5 working days; this extract records neither, so either date fails A6.
HR status; Termination date; Role change date
